nodes.name: exceptions.py
nodes.summary: Defines all framework-level exception classes used throughout Frappe, organized into HTTP-mapped exceptions (ValidationError 417, AuthenticationError 401, PermissionError 403, etc.), domain-specific validation errors (MandatoryError, LinkValidationError, TimestampMismatchError), and infrastructure errors (QueryTimeoutError, QueryDeadlockError, InReadOnlyMode). Most exceptions inherit from ValidationError or base Exception with HTTP status codes.

nodes.name: ValidationError
nodes.summary: Base validation error with HTTP 417 status code. Parent class for ~30 domain-specific validation errors including MandatoryError, LinkValidationError, UniqueValidationError, CharacterLengthExceededError, etc.

nodes.name: AuthenticationError
nodes.summary: Authentication failure exception with HTTP 401 status code. Used when user credentials are invalid or session is not authenticated.

nodes.name: PermissionError
nodes.summary: Permission denied exception with HTTP 403 status code. Raised when authenticated user lacks required permissions.

nodes.name: DoesNotExistError
nodes.summary: Document not found exception (HTTP 404), inherits from ValidationError. Stores the doctype for error reporting context.

nodes.name: frappeclient.py
nodes.summary: HTTP client library for connecting to remote Frappe instances. Provides FrappeClient class with full CRUD operations (get_doc, get_list, insert, update, delete, submit, cancel), authentication via username/password or API key/secret, and a migrate_doctype utility for migrating records between sites.

nodes.name: FrappeClient
nodes.summary: HTTP client for Frappe REST API with session-based auth (login/logout), key-based auth (API key/secret), CRUD methods (get_doc, get_list, insert, update, delete, submit, cancel), value operations (get_value, set_value), and data migration (migrate_doctype, migrate_single). Uses requests library with JSON processing.

nodes.name: FrappeOAuth2Client
nodes.summary: OAuth2 bearer token variant of FrappeClient. Simplified init that uses access_token for Authorization header instead of username/password login.

nodes.name: handler.py
nodes.summary: Central request handler that dispatches API calls and RPC in Frappe. Routes commands through execute_cmd which resolves server scripts or Python methods, enforces whitelist and HTTP method checks. Provides upload_file, download_file, logout endpoints and run_doc_method for executing whitelisted document controller methods.

nodes.name: handle
nodes.summary: Main entry point for handling requests. Reads cmd from form_dict, delegates to execute_cmd (skipping for 'login'), and sets response message with the return data.

nodes.name: execute_cmd
nodes.summary: Executes an RPC command by resolving it to a Python method or server script. Applies whitelist override, checks server script map, resolves method via get_attr, enforces is_whitelisted and is_valid_http_method, then calls the method with form_dict kwargs.

nodes.name: upload_file
nodes.summary: Whitelisted POST endpoint for file uploads. Handles chunked uploads, image optimization, permission checks, MIME type validation for guests, and creates File documents. Supports library file references and custom upload methods.

nodes.name: run_doc_method
nodes.summary: Executes a whitelisted controller method on a document. Loads doc by dt/dn or from JSON, checks permissions and freshness, inspects method signature to pass args correctly, supports CSV response output.

nodes.name: hooks.py
nodes.summary: Frappe app's hooks configuration declaring all integration points: app metadata, JS/CSS bundles, website routes/redirects, doc_events (lifecycle callbacks for all doctypes), scheduler_events (cron, daily, hourly, weekly, monthly jobs), permission_query_conditions, has_permission handlers, request/job lifecycle hooks, override_whitelisted_methods, and global search doctypes.

nodes.name: doc_events
nodes.summary: Maps document lifecycle events to handler functions. The '*' wildcard applies to all doctypes with on_update, on_cancel, on_trash, on_change hooks for notifications, workflows, assignments, file attachments, and search indexing. Specific handlers for Event (Google Calendar sync), Contact (Google Contacts sync), DocType and Page (cache building).

nodes.name: scheduler_events
nodes.summary: Defines all scheduled background jobs: cron jobs every 5/10/15 min (email pull, global search sync, notifications), hourly maintenance (user settings, backups, OAuth cleanup), daily (email digests, auto-repeat, log cleanup), weekly (changelog, updates check), monthly (auto email reports).

nodes.name: permission_query_conditions
nodes.summary: Maps doctypes to their permission query condition functions that generate SQL WHERE clauses for row-level security. Covers Event, ToDo, User, Dashboard, Notification, Note, Kanban, Contact, Address, Communication, Workflow Action, Prepared Report, File.

nodes.name: installer.py
nodes.summary: Site installation and management module. Handles creating new sites (_new_site), database setup (install_db), app installation/removal (install_app, remove_app), site configuration (make_site_config, update_site_config), backup validation, database restore, and MariaDB version compatibility. Core orchestrator for bench site lifecycle operations.

nodes.name: _new_site
nodes.summary: Creates a new Frappe site: initializes directories, installs database, installs frappe app plus configured apps, enables scheduler. Uses filelock for concurrency safety. Supports custom DB type, host, port, socket, and SQL source for restore.

nodes.name: install_app
nodes.summary: Installs a Frappe app on a site: resolves required_apps recursively, syncs doctypes/schemas, runs before/after_install hooks, syncs jobs/fixtures/customizations/dashboards, marks patches as completed, and clears caches.

nodes.name: remove_app
nodes.summary: Uninstalls an app from a site: checks dependencies, runs before/after_uninstall hooks, deletes modules and their linked doctypes (dropping tables), removes from installed_apps, creates backup unless skipped.

nodes.name: install_db
nodes.summary: Sets up the database for a site: creates site config, sets up DB user/schema, bootstraps tables from SQL source or fresh, creates auth/global_search/user_settings tables.

nodes.name: update_site_config
nodes.summary: Updates a key-value pair in site_config.json with filelock protection. Handles type coercion (string to int/bool) and key removal when value is None.

nodes.name: locale.py
nodes.summary: Locale utilities for retrieving language-specific formatting preferences: number format, date format, time format, and first day of the week. Falls back to system defaults when language-specific values are not configured.

nodes.name: middlewares.py
nodes.summary: WSGI middleware for serving static files. StaticDataMiddleware extends Werkzeug's SharedDataMiddleware to add Content-Disposition headers for forced download file types and resolve file paths safely within site-specific public/files directories.

nodes.name: StaticDataMiddleware
nodes.summary: Extends SharedDataMiddleware to serve static files from site-specific directories with path traversal protection (is_relative_to check) and forced download headers for dangerous file extensions.

nodes.name: migrate.py
nodes.summary: Site migration orchestrator that updates a site to the current code version. SiteMigration class runs pre-schema hooks, patches (pre and post model sync), schema sync, then post-schema tasks (jobs, fixtures, customizations, languages, dashboards). Includes atomic decorator for transactional safety and DBQueryProgressMonitor for long-running query visibility.

nodes.name: SiteMigration
nodes.summary: Orchestrates full site migration: setUp (clear cache, kill idle connections, lower lock timeout) -> pre_schema_updates (before_migrate hooks) -> run_schema_updates (patches + schema sync) -> post_schema_updates (sync jobs/fixtures/dashboards/languages, after_migrate hooks) -> tearDown (clear caches, queue search index rebuild).

nodes.name: atomic
nodes.summary: Decorator that wraps a method in a database transaction: commits on success, rolls back on failure. Used on SiteMigration's schema update methods.

nodes.name: DBQueryProgressMonitor
nodes.summary: Daemon thread that polls MariaDB processlist every 10 seconds to display progress of long-running migration queries (>5 seconds). Shows command, time, state, progress percentage, and truncated query text.

nodes.name: model/__init__.py
nodes.summary: Defines core model constants and field metadata used throughout the framework. Categorizes field types (data_fieldtypes, no_value_fields, numeric_fieldtypes, table_fields, display_fieldtypes), defines standard fields (name, owner, creation, modified, etc.), core doctypes list, log types, and provides utilities like delete_fields, get_permitted_fields, and is_default_field.

nodes.name: data_fieldtypes
nodes.summary: Tuple of all field types that store data values (33 types including Currency, Int, Float, Date, Text, Data, Link, Select, etc.). Used to distinguish value-bearing fields from layout/display fields.

nodes.name: default_fields
nodes.summary: Tuple of 8 standard fields present on every document: doctype, name, owner, creation, modified, modified_by, docstatus, idx. Also exported as DEFAULT_FIELDS frozenset.

nodes.name: get_permitted_fields
nodes.summary: Returns list of field names a user is permitted to access for a doctype based on permission level. Core doctypes bypass permission checks. Handles both 'select' and 'read' permission types with appropriate field sets.

nodes.name: delete_fields
nodes.summary: Deletes field definitions from DocField and optionally drops corresponding database columns or Singles records. Handles both single and regular doctypes, with explicit commit for MariaDB DDL.

nodes.name: base_document.py
nodes.summary: Base class for ALL documents in Frappe (1657 lines). BaseDocument provides the foundational document API: dict-like access (get/set/update), child table management (append/extend/remove), database operations (db_insert/db_update), validation (mandatory fields, link validation, select validation, data field validation, length checks, constants), serialization (as_dict/as_json), password handling, formatting, and permission-level field filtering. Also includes get_controller for loading DocType controller classes.

nodes.name: BaseDocument
nodes.summary: Core base class for all Frappe documents with 60+ methods. Provides dict-like document access, child table management (append/extend/remove with auto-init), database CRUD (db_insert with batch child inserts, db_update), comprehensive validation (mandatory fields, links, selects, data fields, constants, length, code fields), serialization (as_dict/as_json/get_valid_dict), password save/retrieval, precision handling, format data, and permission-level field reset.

nodes.name: get_controller
nodes.summary: Returns the locally cached controller class for a DocType. Caches per-site. Delegates to import_controller which resolves custom types to Document class, handles class overrides from hooks, and creates extended classes.

nodes.name: import_controller
nodes.summary: Imports and returns a DocType's controller class. Handles custom doctypes (returns Document/NestedSet), loads module, applies override_doctype_class hooks with subclass validation, creates extended classes, and updates computed child table properties.
